title: Predict: print, debugPrint & terminator
hints: `print` takes `separator:` and `terminator:`; `debugPrint` shows strings with quotes.
`terminator: " | "` means the next print continues on the same line. Arrays always print their elements in debug form.
Line 2 is `1-2-3 | same line`; `debugPrint(name)` prints `"Swift"` with quotes; the array prints as `["Swift", "6"]`.
jsBridge: `print` is `console.log`. `debugPrint` is closer to `console.dir` or `JSON.stringify`: it shows quotes and escapes. `separator:` and `terminator:` control spacing and the trailing newline, which `console.log` can't.
